sections.text: Dry; tip of tongue burning. Pharyngitis.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Catarrhal gastritis with profuse secre-
tion, tendency to ulceration and passive haemorrhage.
Lessens the vomiting in gastric ulcer.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Constant desire to go to stool, with inabil-
ity to pass anything for some time. Chronic diarrhoea,
with offensive mucus. Constipation.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses too profuse. Post-partum haemor-
rhage. Sore nipples. [£«/>. arom.]
